edit.description: `containment_edges` (:2272) is a whole-corpus pass — one `ResolvedEdge` per embedded member across every kind — derived independently at `degree` (:443) and `reached_from` (:543), so a corpus declaring both clause families walks the corpus twice in one run. Fold it onto the already-hoisted walk: add a `containment: Vec<ResolvedEdge>` field to `ResolvedEdgesResult` (:145), derive it inside `resolved_edges` (:1656), and swap the `by_kind` parameter of `degree` and `reached_from` for `containment: &[ResolvedEdge]` — neither reads `by_kind` for anything else. Update the in-module `degree` test call sites (:2947, :2979, :3016, :3047, :3081, :3115, :3139, :3206, :3242) and the per-function 'pays nothing for it' claims (:426-431, :528-531), which the fold supersedes: the family now rides one pass with the resolution walk rather than one per opting-in predicate.
Pass `resolved_edges_result.containment` to `graph::degree` (:654) and `graph::reached_from` (:670) in place of `&by_kind`, and drop the two site comments that explain the per-call derivation.

`explain` calls `graph::resolved_edges` (:1168) and then re-derives the family at :1176; read the shared field instead, which makes :511's standing claim that containment 'rides the same walk' literally true.

The four `degree`/`reached_from` call sites (:700, :703, :793, :816) take the new containment slice. Extend the re-pinned gate walk test (see the blocking entry) to assert the containment family is derived exactly once per run — it now rides `resolved_edges_count()`, so the existing delta-of-1 pin covers it once the derivation moves inside the walk.

summary: The containment incidence family is a whole-corpus pass derived once per opting-in predicate; fold it onto the one hoisted resolution walk every consumer already shares.

per.section: Cost scale is hoisted, and pinned by count

tests.asserts: a real `gate::gate` run over a corpus declaring both a `degree` and a `reached-from` clause derives the containment family once, not once per clause family — the walk count stays 1
the containment arcs a `degree` filter and a `reached-from` via set range over are unchanged by the fold — the existing containment and reached-from suites stay green

acceptance: cargo test green (no verdict moves — the family's contents and the 0052 exclusion of containment from an unfiltered bound are untouched); cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.
notes: Verified on disk: both derivations are unguarded past their opt-in early returns, and neither has a count pin. The fold trades the documented 'a corpus asking for neither pays nothing' property for one unconditional pass over already-loaded members inside a walk that is already made — the cost section's 'computes once per run and is shared, never recomputed per call site' is the authority the doc narration sits under. scoped at a27c3003
